results.rationale: The flat clock gains a raised rim, shadows and reshaped numerals, while its lower watermark disappears. A new hand points toward ten and the eight-pointing hand remains; no hour hand points to nine as the explanation requires. The redundant broad hands make the displayed time ambiguous. Instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid.

The lantern's shape, gold pattern and tassel are retained. Golden branches, petals and a warm glowing gradient satisfy the festive setting, but both requested text blocks are replaced by one crowded central phrase on the lantern. Tangled gold calligraphy overlaps the ornament and impairs readability.
